title: Great app!
body: My therapist recommended this app to me so I could better track my moods along with some physical symptoms and notice correlations with my sleep quality, diet and stress. It’s perfect for distilling that kind of information into reports that make sense. The more I use it the more useful it becomes.
author: ActionGirl

title: Great
body: It was comprehensive and worked well. I never remembered to use it so I deleted my account. You can easily delete your account which I LOVE. Recommend.
author: Big Bearcat

title: The only symptom tracking that ever worked for me
body:
I’ve tried so many symptom tracking apps over the years often resorting to simple spreadsheets. I’d find them really annoying to update (laborious) OR they just lacked features and there wasn’t really any help in tracking. 

Bearable has it all - all the features needed to see trends and find out what’s happening over time. Good looking (important), very few (if any) bugs, huge flexibility, easy to use, and actually fun to update. I love the graphs in particular. 

The fact that the free version isn’t really all that limited shows they really believe in their users and what they’re going through. The ability to sponsor others for a premium upgrade is also a very cool community feature. 

Just using this app I feel less alone.

author: Sheekgeek14

title: Could use improvements
body:

It tracks a lot of things I want but doesn’t sync well with Apple or Fitbit. Some things do and some don’t. I find it a bit insulting that recovery activities include cryotherapy, cupping, hyperbaric chamber, and ice bath but I had to personally add “lie down/rest” and “heating pad”. title: Free version is ok :)
body: I love the idea of this, and even more I adore animals and there is a cute little bear to interact with so for me that’s a big draw lol. But, as someone who is happy to support devs, for me this one isn’t worth the sub price. I would pay a one time unlock right now, but would not feel the need to sub to this at its current cost. I found a few totally free apps that have even more depth (if you’re curious look for chronic health tracking apps produced by medical professionals) so I’ve picked a favourite of those and will track simultaneously in there as well as the free version of this app for now and see how I like it. I was surprised to find that even though I was logged in with my Apple ID I was not able to freely log in from both my iPhone and iPad. That feature isn’t supported and you have to constantly log in and out, making the process a bit of a chore. It’s been a long time since I’ve used an app that couldn’t be logged in on two devices. As someone who is disabled and needs to budget responsibly the yearly cost is just too high to justify right now, even if there is a cute little bear.

author: Ratface3

title: This app is a game changer
body:
As someone with multiple chronic conditions that impact each other and my life in complicated ways, Bearable turns out to be exactly what I need to better understand and manage my health. 

Like a lot of people with conditions that impact executive function, I have a really hard time building new routines and rituals, even if those are crucial to managing my health. So my current favourite feature (of many) are Bearable’s experiments—because being able to see concrete data on how behaviour or other changes are having a specific impact make it so much easier to stick with those changes. 

I also love that James and the team have lived experience with managing complex health conditions—it shows, and the app wouldn’t be half as good without that first-hand knowledge.

title: Neat, but ultimately useless
body:
I used this app for a full year. It’s great for helping you become more mindful of your symptoms, but ultimately kind of useless for finding how your daily actions and choices affect those symptoms.

One big problem is that the app has no notion of statistical power, so when showing correlations, something you might have done a handful of times is given equal weight to something you might have done hundreds of times. That is, the app shows the magnitude of a correlation, but not the likelihood that this magnitude is just a fluke.

author: Doesn't work 102020

title: Pretty comprehensive
body: Loving this app so far. I have been tracking food, symptoms, and sleep across three different apps for years—great to be able to do it all in one! Only two downsides I hope the developers will resolve. 1. Menstrual cycles don’t seem to be their own category—they’re either a “symptom” or a “factor.” Like nutrition and bowel movements, they should be their own category. Additionally, food has limited entries and no time-stamps. If I have more than one snack between meals, they both have to be logged in the same snack entry. And did I have that snack at 9am? 10:30am? No one knows! When relating symptom onset to food allergies/intolerances, time stamps become important. This is still better than using three apps, so I will continue to use this app for now.
author: gina_rb

title: One thing / Une chose
body:
I think the app is really what I was looking for in order to better document my state of health (physical and mental). There is only one detail that slows down my use: app is in English only. In general, I manage but other days I find it a burden (and I use translation apps too often). Hoping that this will be a new challenge for programmers. PS: I love the presentation with colors, icons and font. Usually, there is enough space to write comments (both for items and notes). Well done!!

Je trouve que l’app est vraiment ce que je recherchais afin de mieux documenter mon état de santé (celui physique et mental). Il y a un seul détail qui ralentit mon utilisation: app est en anglais uniquement. En général, je me débrouille mais d’autres jours je trouve que c’est un poids (et j’utilise trop souvent les app de traduction). En espérant que ce sera pour les programmeurs un nouveau défi à réaliser. PS: j’adore la présentation avec les couleurs, icônes et la police d’écriture. title: Not happy with new direction
body: I've been here since before this app was released to the general public, when the developer was asking in the chronic illness forums for advice and feedback. This app was for purchase and was always fair, now it has a monthly subscription service. You posted in these forums that you wanted to help people with chronic illnesses, yet now you want a monthly fee from those who are struggling for features like password protection? Come on. Free apps have basic features like that included. This new direction is more money focused rather than helping people and I can't get behind it. If you really want to help stop charging people indefinitely or charge less.

title: Best App on the App Store
body:
Thank you for making so many essential features available for those who can’t afford paying monthly for an app. Health benefits should be available for everyone, especially those who don’t have jobs or aren’t able to take care of themselves on their own. 

This app is extremely convenient and well-developed. Can’t name another app this good.

P.S. It would be great if there was a way we could update our health information through a PC, like a web version of the app... Thank you so much for all your help and for caring!
author: serzizz

title: The best health tracking app!!
body: I tried countless apps to find one that was as customizable as this one! One of the great things about it is that you can do a lot even without the premium version (although I’m enjoying it so much, I will buy the premium too). It doesn’t hurt that the interface is so user friendly and aesthetically pleasing. Great job, guys!!! ❤️
author: AN__96

title: So helpful.
body: This app is so amazing. I just started a new medication and am trying to figure out if its right for me. It’s so helpful keeping track of my first week using it vs how I’m doing now. Tracking my habits and symptoms has been a great way to figure out what im doing right and wrong, and this app makes it so much easier to track. I appreciate the customization, option of notes, keeping track of different times i feel emotions/symptoms, and how well organized the app is. Great! Highly recommend.
author: stinkstinkfartpoo

title: Phenomenal
body: The developers actively seek out feedback and input from various chronic illness communities. The result is an app that does everything I want it to do, in a simple way! This is a winner!
author: supersam27000

title: Incroyable
body: Je recommande fortement cette application! Peu importe quels sont vos symptômes, l’app en version gratuite offre une quasi infinité de personnalisation!
author: Rottary

title: Finally - something that actually works
body:
This is hands down the best tracker app for someone with chronic illness. It has everything I need to track on it and even syncs up with my Apple Watch. I will be printing out the reports and bringing them to my next specialist appointment. Really like how customizable each tab is. I’m usually terrible at tracking but this app makes it easy. And I know it’s important for my long term
Health.
author: livinstew88

title: Good app, but need help
body: It was a amazing app until the most recent update. It logged me out and is saying my app is outdated. The app is as updated as it can be. I’ve tried deleting it and redownloading it and that didn’t work. This app has helped me a lot so it sucks that it’s not working right now, I’m not sure if this is a problem on my end or a bug...
author: gogovictoria

title: I’m so happy I could cry
body: Finally, everything I ever needed in a health tracker app, and it actually looks aesthetically pleasing too rather than something that was made with Microsoft Paint. Tbh I haven’t started using it yet, I just downloaded it and paid for premium, but I looked though all the features and I’m in awe that something like this exists for people like me
author: chihiropeaches

title: obsessed with this app!!!
body: this app helps me so much, and it’s super customizable, AND the creators are really responsive to feedback! A+, 10/10!
author: Ro.cketships

title: Amazing
body: This is a great app. Well organized and easy to use highly recommend 🥰
author: karot.kake

title: Best Tracker
body: This health tracker is amazing! It is super customizable on what symptoms or factors you want to record and has a user-friendly interface. I really appreciate how much you can access without needing to pay for the premium subscription. It has neat charts that track patterns over the month and gives you little tips. I use this program numerous times a day and really appreciate having it.
author: Teyplays

title: I use it every day!
body:
This is an excellent tracker. I use it for everything from mood, supplements, food, and activities. 

I really enjoy being able to take notes on everything plus the data comparisons are really helpful.  I’m looking forward to future updates that add even more functionality (maybe even a fast tracker 🤞). 

I signed up for the full year account because I believe in this app and it has been really helpful in charting my holistic health journey. Keep up the good work!
author: Brock Tinnell

title: I’m surprised at how great this app is
body: I’ve tried sooo many different ways to track my mood and nothing felt right. This app makes it shockingly easy. It’s easy to personalize and adjust to fit exactly what I want to track. I absolutely LOVE the insight section. I’m better able to see what works and what doesn’t, and adjust my days to accommodate whatever mood I’m in. I love this app, thank you so much for creating it.
author: cakesters

title: They have thought of everything!
body: This app is fantastic. I started using it to track my RA symptoms. After having heart surgery, it has become the best tool to track all my meds and what time I take them, set reminders for all of them, and keep track of all the symptoms and side effects I have. I can then use the charts to see if certain factors are causing/affecting my symptoms. While this might not be an app you want to have to use, if you do need it, it’s the best. It is clear, simple, easy to use, easy to customize, and has everything all in one place. Well done!
author: j121213
